services.intro: Five stages, from a fast one-page launch to custom AI engineering. Pick where you are now — that's where we begin.
services.note: Engagements start with a technical audit, followed by sprints or a monthly retainer, adapting to the evolving needs of your product.

grants.title: Won a European or ODA grant? We deliver the application from your project, on the contract deadlines.
grants.body: We work with startups, SMEs, NGOs, public institutions and business associations. We join the project at any stage, from the funding application to well after it closes.

E.name: EXPRESS PAGE
E.whereYouAre: You need a modern, fast page to validate an idea, win your first customers or replace an outdated site.
E.whatYouGet: A fast-loading 1–3 page landing site, mobile-optimised, wired straight to Telegram or a form so enquiries reach you from day one.
E.whyUs: DIY builders save money now but cost you credibility. A pro page loads faster and actually converts your traffic.
E.pricingTooltip: You pay a fixed amount defined in the contract for a strictly defined scope (Express Page).

B.name: CONCEPT TO SPEC
B.whereYouAre: You have a product or business idea, but it's still theoretical and you need full clarity before investing in development.
B.whatYouGet: A complete execution plan: from user flows and a visual prototype to a clear technical spec, ready to hand to a dev team.
B.whyUs: Skipping the spec phase usually means scope creep later. We align business logic with tech reality before writing any code.
B.pricingTooltip: A fixed-price technical audit to map out requirements, architecture, and exact roadmap before any build.

A.name: DESIGN TO CODE
A.whereYouAre: Your design is ready in Figma, or your visual assets are prepared, and you want a technical team to turn them into well-built production code.
A.whatYouGet: Your Figma screens built as a working app: front end, Postgres database and the API integrations it needs.
A.whyUs: Offshore agencies often produce unmaintainable code. We ship clean, typed, scalable architecture you actually own.
A.pricingTooltip: We work as your dedicated team. You pay a predictable monthly retainer or per sprint, prioritizing features as we go.

C.name: SCALE & EXTEND
C.whereYouAre: You have a live product but need engineering capacity to ship new modules, clear performance bottlenecks or increase delivery speed.
C.whatYouGet: New feature development, code refactoring, database tuning and an architecture ready to scale — with zero downtime.
C.whyUs: Instead of just patching bugs, we modernize your stack iteratively so you can grow without throwing away existing code.
C.pricingTooltip: Ongoing dedicated capacity for active products to ensure stability, continuous delivery, and quick pivots.

D.name: AI PROCESS AUTOMATION
D.whereYouAre: Your team loses dozens of hours on repetitive tasks, manual data processing or fragmented workflows that slow your growth.
D.whatYouGet: LLM steps wired into the tools you already use (n8n, Make or custom code), plus a dashboard where your team reviews every automated action.
D.whyUs: Off-the-shelf AI tools are generic. We build custom automations that fit your exact business process securely.
D.pricingTooltip: Complex custom automations are built in managed sprints, giving you full control over the pace and scope.

about.title: We build responsibly. No excuses.
about.lead: We know how costly delayed timelines, poor communication, and fragile code can be. We only take on projects where we can dedicate our full expertise. You work directly with senior engineers, getting complete visibility into progress and a guarantee that your budget is respected. We are the technical partner you can rely on for the long haul.

ownership.title: Transparency from day one
ownership.body: Source code and infrastructure are set up directly in your own accounts. You retain 100% ownership, zero vendor lock-in, and absolutely no hidden fees.

pricing.title: Owned costs and deadlines
pricing.body: We provide clear estimates for every milestone. If we underestimate technical complexity, we absorb the extra hours. No surprise invoices.

communication.title: Direct technical communication

items.question: What does a project cost?
items.answer: Most of our partnerships operate on a monthly retainer or sprint basis. Before writing code, we conduct a paid diagnostic (audit), resulting in a clear technical specification and roadmap.

items.question: Do you take over someone else's project?
items.answer: Yes, after a paid audit. The audit is a written document: what works, what has to be rewritten, and what it costs to reach production.

items.question: What happens after handover?
items.answer: Thirty days of bug support are included. After that you can keep us on a monthly retainer or run the project with your own team. Both work.
